summary: Initial MVP testing completed successfully. All backend authentication endpoints working correctly (health check, registration, login, token validation). Frontend auth and home screens rendering properly with all required UI elements. Integration between frontend and backend is functioning correctly.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web deprecation warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow' instead.
React Native Web warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'

action_items: Optional: Replace shadow* props (shadowColor, shadowOffset, shadowOpacity, shadowRadius) with boxShadow for React Native Web compatibility
Optional: Move pointerEvents from props to style object for proper React Native Web usage
critical_code_review_comments: ✅ Backend properly excludes MongoDB _id field using {"_id": 0} projection
✅ Environment variables correctly used (MONGO_URL, JWT_SECRET, EMERGENT_LLM_KEY)
✅ JWT authentication implemented securely with bcrypt password hashing
✅ Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL for API calls
✅ All interactive elements have testID attributes for testing
✅ Proper React Native components used (View, Text, TouchableOpacity, TextInput)
✅ Error handling implemented in AuthContext and API calls
✅ Input validation on both frontend and backend
Note: Deprecation warnings are cosmetic and don't affect functionality

context_for_next_testing_agent: All MVP features tested and working. Backend authentication is solid. Frontend auth flow and home screen are functional. The fact-check endpoint (POST /api/fact-check) was not tested as it requires real video URLs and takes 30-60 seconds to process (downloads video with yt-dlp, transcribes with Whisper, analyzes with GPT-5.2). Minor React Native Web deprecation warnings present but not blocking functionality.
